rv.q: This delightful American show, set in Memphis in 1955, pins down a pivotal moment in musical history with liberal gaiety.
It boasts some of the most thrilling vocal work you'll find on the London stage, in its roof-raising evocation of the birth of rock'n' roll.
The first half blazes with a joyous R&B power and songs that ape the era while smuggling in sophisticated lyrics.

cn.t: Energetic musical about 1950s rock'n'roll's birth draws praise for thrilling vocals and dynamic choreography, but critics find its treatment of racism glib and its story predictable, with generic Bon Jovi-penned songs.
